title: NSC study on disclosure of recovered craft under George W. Bush
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of NSC study on disclosure of recovered craft under George W. Bush, about 2000s at National Security Council; Office of Net Assessment, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: National Security Council; Office of Net Assessment

tellings.quote: Now, you know, there was a report that um that the National Security Council under uh George W. Bush did commission a study of whether the time was had come for quote disclosure

plain: A former US Senate staffer, Kirk McConnell, says there was a report that the National Security Council, the White House's group of top security advisers, under President George W. Bush commissioned a study, through a Pentagon planning office called the Office of Net Assessment, on whether the time had come for disclosure, meaning telling the public about recovered craft. He connects this to Sean Kirkpatrick, a former head of the Pentagon's UFO office. If true, it would mean the White House seriously weighed going public in the 2000s.
